summary_en: SK-03 Corporation tender offer for CE Holdings ordinary shares at ¥1,650/share. Target acquisition: 10.49M shares (67.7% of S/O). Minimum acceptance threshold 4.97M shares. Offer period: 30 business days, Aug 6–Sep 17, 2026. Settlement Sep 29, 2026.
title_en: Notice of commencement of tender offer by SK-03 Corporation for shares (code 4320) of CE Holdings Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: SK-03 Corporation, formed June 9, 2026, has announced a tender offer to acquire ordinary shares of CE Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard and Sapporo Exchange listed) at ¥1,650 per share. The offer runs for 30 business days from August 6 to September 17, 2026, with settlement on September 29, 2026. Target acquisition is 10.49M shares; the minimum acceptance threshold (required for consummation) is 4.97M shares (32.1% of shares outstanding). No upper limit on shares to be acquired was disclosed. Nomura Securities will act as offer agent. The filing does not disclose the total yen amount, board stance (recommend/oppose/neutral), or controlling shareholder interests.
